Maria: Heads-up — proposing a new 'anchor sampler' for judge onboarding to reduce bias and noisy tiebreaks. Want quick feedback before I draft an RFC. cc @Nidhi @Ben
Ben: High level goals? coverage, speed, or lower false positives on quality regressions?
Maria: All of the above but prioritized: 1) diverse coverage across task types, 2) explicit edge-case oversampling, 3) fairness probes (demographic + prompt-style), 4) stable tie-break behavior. Keep samples small-ish (2–3k anchors).
Nidhi: +1 on stratified sampling. We should stratify by prompt task, prompt length bucket, and model-answer length. Also add adversarial perturbations (paraphrase, punctuation/noise).
Eva: For CI gating: do we pick a concrete agreement metric? What threshold would block a bring-up?
Ben: Suggestion: primary judge must hit pairwise Cohen's kappa >= 0.6 AND Krippendorff's alpha >= 0.55 on anchors. If below, fallback to ensemble of 3 judges (different seeds/models).
Maria: Example sampling command I'm thinking of:
```bash
# sample anchors
python tools/sample_anchors.py \n  --strata=task_type,answer_length \n  --oversample=rare_intents:5 \n  --seed=42 \n  --perturb=paraphrase,typo
```
Sam: For metrics: record both pairwise kappa and alpha, plus distributional drift (KL) vs our baseline anchors. Also log per-stratum agreement so we can diagnose where judges fail.
Nidhi: Tie-breaker heuristic idea: use a "calibration-first" tiebreaker. Each judge has a calibration score from evals; compute consensus_score = sum(judge_vote * judge_calibration). If tie persists, break by higher average confidence; if still tied, deterministic hash(seed + prompt_id) to pick reproducibly.
Eva: For CI integration: fail the model bring-up if any of: alpha < 0.55, pairwise kappa < 0.6, OR avg quality delta vs baseline <= -1.5%. Also post a human review flag for any stratum with agreement < 0.5.
Ben: Agree on deterministic fallback — important for rollouts. We should also surface a dashboard widget: per-anchor agreement heatmap + examples for low-agreement anchors.
Maria: I'll draft the RFC and a PR that adds the sampling config + a new GitHub actions job that runs anchor-sampling + judge-agreement check. Targeting next Wed. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
